submission.natural_language_explanation: N2409+ is a local Romance-language detector: reading the orthography of the current token plus the two or three tokens before it, it fires at 3-6 across Spanish, Portuguese, Catalan or Galician prose (prompt peak 4.5-7) and at 2-4 across French or Italian prose, while staying at 0.0 on English (even Latinate English such as "organization's constitution ... administration"), German, Polish, Turkish, code and mathematics, so a prompt is predicted active only when its text is Romance or when it contains a Romance word or name. It is retrospective, not lookahead: inside English prose it rises to 1.5-5.5 on a single Romance token (Diego 4.2, Francesco 5.5, Moreno 2.3, casa 3.1) but reads 0.0 on Germanic or Slavic names (Smith, Schmidt, Hansen, Kowalski), and its output adds probability to Spanish function words (de, que, un, la, en, con) rather than preparing one specific next token.
